ANYHOW.gloss: used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement
ANYHOW.definition: Used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement.

YAWN.gloss: an involuntary intake of breath through a wide open mouth
YAWN.definition: An involuntary intake of breath through a wide open mouth; usually triggered by fatigue or boredom.
YAWN.example: He could not suppress a yawn.

NOW.definition: In the historical present; at this point in the narration of a series of past events.
NOW.example: President Kennedy now calls in the National Guard.

ANY.gloss: one or some or every or all without specification
ANY.definition: One or some or every or all without specification.
ANY.example: Give me any peaches you don't want.

WAY.gloss: how something is done or how it happens
WAY.definition: How something is done or how it happens.

HAY.gloss: grass mowed and cured for use as fodder
HAY.definition: Grass mowed and cured for use as fodder.

WAN.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble.
WAN.example: The pale light of a half moon.

WHY.gloss: the cause or intention underlying an action or situation, especially in the phrase…
WHY.definition: The cause or intention underlying an action or situation, especially in the phrase `the whys and wherefores'.

OWN.example: He owns three houses in Florida.

WON.gloss: the basic unit of money in South Korea
WON.definition: The basic unit of money in South Korea.
